notes.title: Upcoming Major Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics

Thanks to your valuable feedbacks via emails and Discord, we have been working hard making significant improvements to the game. In the upcoming update, we are excited to introduce a completely new multiplayer campaign, a reworked singleplayer campaign, and a host of new puzzles and entities with fresh, dynamic behaviors. 

We are also focused on clarifying some of the more abstract elements to ensure a smoother experience for all players. However, we realized that we need a little more time to perfect these features and improve overall quality of life. As a result, we have decided to postpone the update to ensure everything meets our standards. 

We truly appreciate your patience and understanding, and we cannot wait to share the update with you soon. 

Stay tuned for more details, and thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Future Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics,
There will be a major update at the [b]end of 2024[/b] with a [b]discount[/b]

With the help of your feedbacks this update include lots of features.
[h2]Singleplayer Campaign[/h2]
* Map Changes
* Item and monster density and puzzle difficulty adjustments

[h2]Multiplayer ( At least 2 player required )[/h2]
* 10 new maps with new puzzles. Additional maps are in development
* New Currency System
* New Multiplayer Lobby

[h2]Visual Update[/h2]
* UI and UX changes
* Main Character visual update

[h2]Supporter Pack DLC[/h2]
* Supporter pack owners can customize the main character outfit colours
